Remote senior frontend developer salary expectations in Canada

The average salary for remote senior frontend developers in Canada is CA$126,900 per year. This is based on data from 37 job openings.

Our advanced AI searches the internet for remote job openings and posts them on our website. We use the salary data from these job postings to calculate salary expectations.


Below is a breakdown of salary data by years of experience:

EXPERIENCE	NUMBER OF ROLES ANALYZED	AVERAGE SALARY


🟢 Junior Frontend Developer (1-2 yrs)

	3	CA$0


🟡 Mid-level Frontend Developer (2-4 yrs)

	16	CA$118,167


🟠 Senior Frontend Developer (5-9 yrs)

	17	CA$153,125


🔴 Lead Frontend Developer (10+ yrs)

	1	CA$201,500
